rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Official ilert MCP server that provides AI assistants with direct access to alerting and incident management resources through the ilert platform. Built by ilert GmbH, the implementation uses a remote Streamable HTTP transport architecture hosted at mcp.ilert.com, requiring only an ilert API key for authentication rather than local installation. Designed for DevOps teams and incident responders who want conversational access to their alerting workflows, incident data, and on-call management through AI assistants like Claude, Cline, Cursor, and Windsurf.
